{{Top|leg}}
The '''Needle's Eye''' was a section of track on the [[Boonta Training Course]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Located past the track's halfway mark, the Needle's Eye was a short, straight section after the third tunnel turn where the cliff walls narrowed to a width that allowed only a single [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] to pass.<ref name="TGM">{{GamerCite|1|Tatooine Grudge Match}}</ref>
